title: On the iPhone, a failed phone-record read keeps the previous record text in memory, so text-based features may show the previous record's content until a read succeeds.
evidence: ios/HealthRoadmap/MyData/RecordStore.swift showPhone: the phoneUnreadable effect clears the drawing and sets the problem but leaves recordJSON as it was (RecordStore.Source.Effect.unreadable). Readers of recordJSON: Share, the chat's record context, Apple Health writes. Found in the Source union design (leads S10, S23, H28); not changed there
